answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 4528 Country: India Title: I am an Engineer working in software firm.I have problem performing wazu in office when washing legs as people object to my washing legs.So is there any solution where in I can avoid washing legs? Question: Assalamuwalikum, I am an Engineer working in software firm.I have problem performing wazu in office when washing legs as people object to my washing legs.So is there any solution where in I can avoid washing legs? Khuda Hafiz Answer ID: 4528 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1128/972=B -1429) It is obligatory to wash feet in wudu . It is up to you now to make wudu once and retain it, so you can keep performing salah with that wudu as long as it is intact. Or you should make wudu once and wear leather socks, and when wudu is broken, wash all parts of wudu and pass on wet hands over the socks up to the shank. You can do like this every day. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
